threads.body: `IncomingMessage` is a stream and can emit an `error` event; without a listener, an emitted error will crash the process. Add a `request.on("error", ...)` handler (and consider also `response.on("error", ...)`) to fail the scenario run cleanly rather than terminating unexpectedly.

replies.body:
Addressed in 6f3ad756e2f47425e1a6187752b4240c4f030790.

Analysis: The client now rejects when its response stream fails. The server races standard-input shutdown against request or response failure, so runScenario receives the error. The server also installs binding listeners before listen and removes the unused listener after either event.

Upsides: Stream and binding failures fail the scenario instead of crashing, hanging, or being swallowed by a settled promise.

Downsides: The server keeps one pending failure promise for its lifetime and adds two listeners per exchange.
